notes: Stops relying on the fragile Hub-to-Quick-Reference Vault handoff. When Quick Reference is locked, its Unlock Vault control now opens the existing Secure Vault inside the current page. After the authorized passphrase succeeds, the protected session is accepted in the same page, the unlock panel closes, and Shared/Private authorized records render immediately. No decrypted Vault data is written to persistent localStorage. Adaptive Checklist and encrypted Vault records are unchanged.
name: TEE v3.4.74 — Inline Vault Unlock
